description: This PHP class defines a REST API controller named DatabaseConfigAPI used for handling database configuration during a system upgrade process in the OrangeHRM software. It provides methods to handle POST requests for setting database info and GET requests for retrieving stored database configuration.

classes.name: DatabaseConfigAPI
classes.description: A REST API controller for managing database configuration during the upgrade process.

methods.name: handlePost
methods.description: Handles POST requests to save database connection details submitted by the client and verifies the connection.

methods.name: handleGet
methods.description: Handles GET requests to retrieve the stored database configuration details.
